Add only explicit optional selector representation hooks where needed for admission, source-only messages, selector-target serialization, actual prompt/representation metadata and reload runner; keep historical defaults/legacy outputs and all numerical/model/loss/attention/resource primitives unchanged. No global prompt swapping, monkey-patching or duplicate training loop.

Route future selector fit/reload by one exact freeze version through the existing association_adapter.py fit/reload role and unchanged allowed CLI arguments. Reuse the reviewed runtime/model/dependency locks and source protection conventions, including actual physical versus canonical source bytes. Future fit must stage training inputs only; development remains in a later separate reload. No shared guard/resource/dependency edits and no new containment action/flag or model acquisition.

Use a small CPU admission/encoder/dispatch check focused on the real accepted data and target isolation: raw selector target instead of expanded strings, prompt mask plus EOS boundary, unchanged source lexical view/metadata, strict rejected-source/split/null/pointer behavior, historical default path preservation and no stage permission for PREP. Do not repeat completed codec/teacher/security campaigns.
